claim_text: Grouped-query attention lets several queries share one key and value, so the KV cache grows with the number of KV heads

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of grouped-query attention from arXiv 2305.13245. Watch the kv_cache number: it grows only with kv heads, while q_heads sharing each block grow with group.

questions.q: Set kv to 1 and watch q_heads. Do you expect the query heads to shrink too?
questions.why: Tests MQA misunderstanding that fewer KV heads means fewer queries.

questions.q: Set group to 1 and watch q_heads and kv_cache?
questions.why: Shows MHA regime where each query has its own KV head.

questions.q: Set kv to 8 and watch kv_cache?
questions.why: Reads cache growth with KV heads.

questions.q: Set seq to 1024 and watch kv_cache?
questions.why: Reads cache growth with sequence length.

ctx.fillText("MHA = " + fmt(1), 340, 296); ctx.fillText("group axis", 330, 322); function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } }
